description.value: Arthouse Hotel is a spacious boutique hotel on the Upper West Side with rooms, suites, and lofts. Guests can eat without leaving the building at the Arthouse Bar, Serafina, or RedFarm. It is a comfortable, residential base close to Central Park and the Museum of Natural History.
